Where else on earth can you explore a bustling local market, eat fresh seafood on a pristine beach at sunset, and casually meet up with a world leader for coffee?

Welcome to Timor-Leste! Today, we are on an epic full-day mission to uncover the absolute best local food, meet amazing people, and discover why this hidden island gem needs to be on your travel bucket list.

We kick off the morning at 8:00 AM meeting up with Cesar at Skyra Coffee Shop before diving headfirst into the vibrant chaos of Taibesi Market. But the day takes a wild turn at 10:00 AM when we head to Kafe Atsabe for a sit-down coffee with none other than José Ramos-Horta, the President of Timor-Leste. He shares some absolutely shocking insights into the country's rapid population growth while we dig into traditional sago pancakes!

From there, the culinary marathon continues through local institutions like MLO Restaurant, traditional home-cooked stews like Batar da'an, a comforting bowl of local street food Bakso, and a perfect night-time seafood finish right on the coast.

08:00 AM - Skyra Coffee Shop, Dili (Meeting Cesar Gaio)
09:00 AM - Taibesi Market, Dili (Local Market Exploration)
10:00 AM - Kafe Atsabe, Dili (Coffee with President José Ramos-Horta)
12:00 PM - MLO Restaurant, Dili (Massive Local Lunch)
03:00 PM - Traditional Batar da'an Dish (Corn & Mung Bean Stew)
05:00 PM - Indonesian Bakso Street Food Stall
07:00 PM - Beachside Seafood Skewers at Night
